source.authority: Official AFSÜ Faculty of Pharmacy directive; report format in Appendix EK-1

scope.documentKind: Course research-project report, not a thesis.
scope.primarySections: Appendix EK-1 report-writing requirements, especially §§1.3–1.12, §2, §§2.2–2.5, plus labeled examples EK-1.1–1.4.
scope.excludedFromReportLayout: Course administration, grading table and poster rules are not thesis/report pages. EK-2 poster is a separate deliverable; page 2 Table 1 is assessment criteria, not a report-table template.

value.print: computer prepared; print on one side only

value.decorativeEmphasis: Use bold/italic/underline only when subject matter requires; no arbitrary emphasis.

value.firstLineIndent: none; paragraph starts at same alignment as body
value.footnotes: single spacing; a few lines maximum
value.paragraphSpacingBetweenParagraphs: 12 pt total; the source does not specify distribution between Word before/after fields.
value.bodyAlignment: Paragraphs start at the same text-block left edge; left/justified alignment is UNKNOWN.

levels2to4.case: Title Case; conjunctions such as ve/veya/ile remain lowercase

value.deeperHeadings: Only if necessary: unnumbered and omitted from table of contents.
value.spacing: 12 pt after main heading before text; 12 pt between section end and next subsection; subsection text starts at body left edge.

value.language: Clear Turkish following Turkish spelling rules; third-person passive is preferred.
value.sentenceInitialNumerals: Write out numbers beginning a sentence or line, except dates.
value.numbersInText: Numbers up to ten are written as words; larger numbers as digits.
value.punctuation: One character space after comma, semicolon, period.

evidence: PDF p.7, §2 lists outline/front matter and five main sections; the short outline omits Onay.
PDF p.10, §2.2 describes and orders Onay before Beyan, with signature requirements.
PDF p.13, EK-1.3 and EK-1.4 provide labeled approval and declaration examples.
requirements.resolution: Use Onay after İç Kapak and before Beyan: the detailed §2.2 and labeled EK-1.3 example establish the approval page; §2 outline omission is recorded as a conflict.

value.outerCoverTypography: 14 pt Times New Roman (as stated for outer-cover contents)
value.innerCoverPaper: same normal paper as the report
value.exampleOuterCoverLogos: Two logos are present in labeled EK-1.1 example; text does not explicitly mandate logos.

requirements.exampleFiller: EK-1.3 contains a named 2022 project and date; treat these as illustrative sample text, not fixed fields.

value.abstractTr: One page maximum; single-spaced; Roman-numbered; answers what/why/how and summarizes findings/results; no internal headings such as Amaç/Yöntem/Sonuç; no in-text citations; avoid abbreviations/numbering unless needed; end with bold “Anahtar Sözcükler:” and up to five alphabetized Turkish keywords, initial letters uppercase, comma separated.
value.abstractEn: English translation of Turkish abstract/title/keywords; same limits, single-spaced, one page maximum, Roman-numbered; up to five alphabetized keywords after bold “Keywords”.
value.tableOfContents: All special pages except outer cover, all headings/subheadings in document order, both abstracts, references and appendices; show page numbers; Roman-numbered.
value.indexes: Tables/figures/photos list only when relevant. Symbols/abbreviations list only when needed. Lists alphabetical where specified and Roman-numbered. Index heading centered; list captions match in-text wording/format.

evidence: PDF p.10–11, §2.2 Dizinler and Simgeler ve Kısaltmalar Dizini

value.consistency: same font and size on all page numbers
value.frontMatter: small Roman numerals from report beginning through immediately before Giriş
value.mainAndBackMatter: Arabic numerals from Giriş through end of report

unknown: Exact page-number font and point size.

Whether either cover counts as a page and whether a number is visibly printed on it. The rule says the front section from the report beginning through Giriş is Roman-numbered but does not give a cover display exception.
evidence: PDF p.10, §2.2 (Onay and Beyan Roman numbering)

value.inText: §1.10 gives Harvard author-year citation examples; author surname/year may appear at sentence start or end. Two authors joined by “ve”; three or more use first author + “ve ark.” + year. Multiple sources ordered oldest to newest; same author by year; same-author same-year works use a/b/c. Non-author sources use title/year. Web sources include access date; software citations identify name/version; personal communications may be cited in text with type/date but are omitted from references; avoid indirect citations, and if unavoidable limit to two sources.
value.referenceList: Alphabetical by author surname; unnumbered; include all cited works and cite every listed work in text; retain source language; Index Medicus journal abbreviations; if >6 authors list first six then et al. for English or ve ark. for Turkish; one-spaced with 6 pt between references.
value.formats: Examples/formulas are provided for books, book chapters, journal articles, conference papers, reports, theses, authorless sources, laws/regulations, newspapers, electronic journals and websites.

requirements.ambiguity: §1.10 concretely demonstrates Harvard, while §2.4.1 says reference rendering follows the selected citation system. No alternative system is specified in this directive; preserve the explicit Harvard examples and alphabetical reference-list rules.

value.placement: Visuals no larger than one page centered; larger objects on consecutive pages immediately after first discussion; do not exceed text block. Captions do not exceed object width and are centered.
value.numbering: Tables, figures and equations have independent sequences, numbered per main chapter with chapter and sequence digits (e.g., Tablo 1.1, Şekil 1.1); cite captions in text.
value.tableCaption: Above table, centered within table edges; 10 pt, single spacing; 6 pt between last caption line and table top. Extra table explanation below table, 10 pt single-spaced.
value.figureCaption: Below figure; description 10 pt, single-spaced; 6 pt gap from the figure lower edge to the caption; keep 12 pt between the main text and the complete visual-plus-caption block.
value.images: Photo reproductions should retain near-original quality; copies of color photographs remain color.

value.abbreviations: Use nonstandard abbreviations only when needed; define once at first use; include an alphabetical preliminary list of symbols/abbreviations.
value.units: Use SI units and standard symbols/prefixes; do not add periods to unit symbols; place a space between quantity and unit.

conflictsAndUnknowns.issue: Outline §2 on p.7 omits Onay although detailed §2.2 on p.10 and sample EK-1.3 on p.13 establish it.
conflictsAndUnknowns.handling: Approval page is included after inner cover and before declaration, citing detailed rule/example.

conflictsAndUnknowns.issue: Heading example in §1.7 on p.4 says “Giriş ve Amaç”; the actual section outline and §2.3 use “GİRİŞ” and instruct aims/hypothesis at the end of that section.
conflictsAndUnknowns.handling: Use GİRİŞ as the required section title; include aim/hypothesis in final paragraph per §2.3. The parenthetical heading wording remains a source inconsistency.

conflictsAndUnknowns.issue: Exact page-number point size/font and visible numbering of covers are not specified.
Font and point size of cover fields other than explicit 14pt Times outer cover and 14pt bold inner title are not specified.
Signatory-name and date typesetting beyond labels/roles in sample is not prescribed; do not freeze sample names/date.
